purpose: Document separately governed post-v1 research directions, dependencies, evidence gates, and sequencing without retrospectively expanding AEGIS Research Core v1.0.
mandatory_governance: future work is not a completed v1 capability
each experimental track requires its own prospective protocol before implementation or evaluation
new datasets tasks populations modalities metrics thresholds and hypotheses must be frozen prospectively
negative findings from v1 remain valid historical evidence
selector failure must not be converted into classifier non-robustness
official test access remains separately governed
production readiness and autonomous attribution remain not established
national-security or threat-intelligence use remains analyst decision support unless separately validated and authorized
future releases must not mutate the immutable v1.0 tag or commit
planned_progression: Step2 frozen evidence and dependency inventory for post-v1 tracks
Step3 structured post-v1 research roadmap and sequencing
Step4 roadmap traceability audit and complete post-v1 packaging closure
